title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-2u0i: multi_fragment_single_window has invalid rule_id=20
description:
The test `multi_fragment_single_window` in `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs:54` passes `rule_id = 20` to `FragmentSender::new()`.

`FragmentSender::new()` calls `check_rule()` (`fragment.rs:446`, defined at `fragment.rs:91-97`) which rejects any value not equal to `RULE_ID_A_TO_B (0x78)` or `RULE_ID_B_TO_A (0x79)`. Passing `20` causes `UnsupportedRule` error, and `.unwrap()` panics.

The old code (HEAD~1) used 4 args (`FragmentSender::new(&payload, 20, tile_size, 7)`) which would not compile since `new()` only accepts 3 args: `(payload, rule_id, receiver_limit)`. The fix correctly reduced to 3 args but used `20` as rule_id instead of a valid value like `0x78`.

Fix: change `20` to `0x78` on line 54.
